response.sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) AS item_share FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS type_avg_quantity, AVG(item_count) AS type_avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS type_avg_item_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(type_avg_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(type_avg_item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(type_avg_item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM type_stats;
